instruction.text: Compare the animals and vehicle and write the adjective fast, adding a suffix where necessary.

atoms.sound: The leopard is faster than the cat.
atoms.b: The leopard is ((faster)) than the cat.

atoms.sound: The car is the fastest of all three.
atoms.b: The car is the ((fastest)) of all three.

instruction.text: Add the suffix to the word.
Add the suffix '-er' or '-est' to the word.

atoms.a: She can run faster than last year.
atoms.b: She can run fast((er)) than last year.

atoms.a: My dog is the calmest animal at the vets.
atoms.b: My dog is the calm((est)) animal at the vets.

atoms.a: Luke is the meanest boy at school.
atoms.b: Luke is the mean((est)) boy at school.

atoms.a: Sam got the highest mark in the class on the spelling test.
atoms.b: Sam got the high((est)) mark in the class on the spelling test.
